message: I want to return the keyboard from A-11. I opened it but don't like it.

result.title: Returns window
result.text: Unopened items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened items may be returned within 14 days of delivery for a refund minus a 10% restocking fee. Return shipping is paid by the customer unless the item arrived damaged or was sent in error.

arguments.message: A-11 was delivered on 2 Sep, 8 days ago, so as an opened item it is within the 14-day window. The refund would be £80.10 (£89.00 less the 10% restocking fee), and you pay return shipping. (POL-101)
